scope: Eight base batches, eight completed 20M panels and seventy-one new followup singleton queries: two Batch 02, seven Batch 03, ten Batch 04, eleven Batch 05, sixteen Batch 06, nine Batch 07 and sixteen Batch 08. Sixteen unique reused Batch 08 played queries remain counted only in the original panel. Mac, pilots and abandoned transition costs remain separate.
limits: Measured VM lifetimes priced at recorded rate, not billing. Mean scaling only; panel sizes, discovered alternatives and availability vary. Inclusive scenarios retain ancillary storage/transfer/operations and recovery assumptions. Cloud-stage timing excludes preflight, retrieval, review pauses and final synthesis.

The current sixteen-query followup is complete, not pending. Then allow 2–4 hours for final synthesis and independent challenge. These allowances are planning assumptions, not measured service guarantees. This supports Friday evening batch completion and Friday night–Saturday morning final diagnosis; it does not restore the obsolete Saturday-central forecast.
calendar_estimate.uncertainty: More consequential roots, new alternatives, regional stockouts or substantive review findings can extend these windows. No scientific coverage will be truncated to meet an estimate.
